{{Otheruses|Green|more=Belt}}
The '''Greenbelt''' was an agricultural region of [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]] located far from the famed [[Teyr Rift]]. Unlike areas closer to the rift, the Greenbelt did not depend on tourism to keep it's economy strong. The cities [[Griann]] and [[Sodonna]] were located within this region.<ref name="TEGTPAM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
